profile.headline: Software Engineer at ClassDojo
profile.summary:
Specialties: * Programming languages: C, C++, Java, Visual Basic, HTML, CSS, PHP, Perl, JavaScript, SQL, Assembly (MIPS)

* Operating systems: Linux (Red Hat Enterprise Linux 5, Ubuntu), Mac OS X, Solaris, Windows 98 – 7

* Software: Adobe Dreamweaver, Adobe Photoshop CS2 – 4, Eclipse, Netbeans, Microsoft Office Suite, Microsoft Visual Studio, Subversion

positions.title: Undergraduate Research Assistant
positions.description:
• Responsible for interface design, data collection and software testing with script writing with using C, C++, Java, Python, or/and Perl depending on the project
• Created web applications for graduate students and professors to aid in their research

positions.title: Lab attendant
positions.description:
• Manage 44 computers available for all computer science students
• Distribute login credentials to 2 servers to all computer science students
• Train new employees on lab policies and procedures
• Volunteer to assist students with technical as well as Java-related problems
